description: The SALT phase-down uses modified AGI: AGI increased by the § 911 exclusion (§ 164(b)(7)(B)(iv); worksheet lines 2–4). Single 2025: wages $620,000 of which $130,000 is excluded foreign earned income → AGI $490,000, MAGI $620,000. $40,000 − 30% × $120,000 = $4,000 → the $10,000 floor. (Using AGI alone left the full $40,000.)
